idea: A simpler Notion for small remote teams
icp: 5-20 person remote teams that tried Notion and found it too heavy
job: keep shared docs and light task tracking in one place without learning a database tool
current_workaround: Notion with a strict 'few blocks only' convention, or Google Docs + Drive folders
buyer_vs_user: user is any team member; payer is the team lead or ops manager

claims.title: Pain exists
claims.go_criterion: >=2 independent platforms quote the same complexity complaint

claims.title: ICP match
claims.statement: small remote teams are the ones in pain
claims.go_criterion: complaint volume concentrates in teams of 5-20, not solo users

claims.title: Payment holds
claims.statement: they would pay $15/seat for a simpler tool
claims.go_criterion: >=3 independent sources show payment behaviour at a similar price

claims.title: Model holds
claims.statement: per-seat SaaS is the right model
claims.go_criterion: >=1 live per-seat rival that is growing
